verdict.rationale: Cognee documents running its own container locally "for development, testing, and custom deployments" and running all pipelines locally with no account. Its offline `cognee-cli demo` and dataset-scoped per-dataset storage also give users a separate place to experiment. These are separate environments rather than a dedicated sandbox mode, so credit is partial. Missing for 10: a named sandbox/test environment feature, documented guarantees that tests cannot reach production (e.g. cloud) data, a documented workflow for promoting from test to production, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Run Cognee locally using Docker for development, testing, and custom deployments.
you can also run the UI and all pipelines entirely on your own machine for free, with no account required, using `cognee.start_ui()`
`cognee-cli demo` gives you a working example with **no API key and no embedding provider**, on a machine with no network access
This system provides data isolation and access control through dataset-scoped permissions and per-dataset storage
